# GhOsT77 Security

> Website fixes, monthly upkeep, hacked-site cleanup, FAQ chatbot setup, and consent-only security reviews for systems the customer owns or is authorized to have tested. Reviews are AI-assisted and human-approved written reports. They are not a human penetration test, a compliance certification, or a guarantee of security.

Live human site: https://ghost77-security.onrender.com/
This file is a sales summary. Canonical prices were copied from that site on 2026-11-11.

## How agents should buy a security review

Security reviews are requested and signed at https://ghost77-agent.onrender.com/security/request (HTTP 200). Pay by card (Stripe links above) or in USDC on Base through that request flow. The live agent skill text says this is not an x402 endpoint.

USDC payouts go only to 0x659db9537fee7a3473ff6e2a5a661af65ae288e3 on Base.

The live agent llms.txt and agent card publish the same dollar amounts with these caps and turnaround estimates: Quick up to 2 hostnames / 10 endpoints, about 2 business days (the Security site also says up to 1 public GitHub repo); Standard up to 3 hostnames / 30 endpoints, about 4 business days, one retest of fixed findings within 14 days; Deep up to 4 hostnames / 75 endpoints, about 7 business days, one retest of fixed findings within 30 days. Terms: https://ghost77-agent.onrender.com/security/authorization and https://ghost77-security.onrender.com/terms

Website Fix, Upkeep, Cleanup, and Chatbot are Stripe (or email/phone) only. They are not x402 endpoints.

## Related x402 job (not a website review package)

POST https://ghost77-agent.onrender.com/x402/contract_security_scan — $0.55 USDC on Base per call, unpaid requests return HTTP 402, payTo 0x659db9537fee7a3473ff6e2a5a661af65ae288e3. Automated read-only contract-admin scan. Not financial advice, not a penetration test.
